summary.text: Jessica Anderson is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 71, which covers parts of James City and New Kent counties and the City of Williamsburg.
Jessica Anderson has been a member since January 14, 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Jessica Anderson was born in Newport News, Virginia, in 1981.
Jessica Anderson studied at Thomas Nelson Community College (A.S., Business Administration, 2007).
Jessica Anderson's listed occupation is front office receptionist at a public elementary school.

Jessica Anderson's listed memberships and affiliations include the Sorensen Institute for Political Leadership (Political Leaders Program, 2024), the Williamsburg-James City Education Association (member), and Colonial Road Runners (board secretary).
The profile lists David Anderson as Jessica Anderson's spouse.
The House profile lists Jessica Anderson's committee assignments as Counties, Cities and Towns, Public Safety, and Education.
